note: Skills a host lists in every session, with short descriptions applied to the installed copies only. Everything else is installed whole in the library and reached through dpe-skill-finder and the skill-hint hook. Keep this small: every listed skill is paid for in every session, and hosts cut a long list to bare names.

descriptions.cofounder: Use for mixed product, engineering, design or growth asks.
descriptions.dpe-engineering-delivery: Use to implement a change end to end: plan, tests, review, verify.
descriptions.dpe-tdd-loop: Use for test-first or red-green-refactor work.
descriptions.dpe-diagnose-loop: Use for hard bugs: reproduce, isolate, fix, add a regression test.
descriptions.verification-before-completion: Use before saying work is done: run the checks and show evidence.
descriptions.minimal-fix: Use for the smallest change that fixes a scoped bug or CI failure.
descriptions.dpe-rigorous-code-review: Use for skeptical review of a diff or PR: correctness, risk, missing tests, and whether it meets its goal.
descriptions.dpe-code-revamp: Use for safe refactors and legacy cleanup without needless churn.
descriptions.dpe-search-first: Use before writing new code: look for an existing package or utility.
descriptions.dpe-project-understanding: Use to learn an unfamiliar repo: what it is, how it runs, conventions.
descriptions.dpe-codebase-analysis: Use to trace call chains and side effects through existing code.
descriptions.writing-plans: Use to write a step-by-step plan before multi-file work.
descriptions.dpe-subagent-delegation: Use to split independent work across subagents or get a fresh reviewer.
descriptions.dpe-api-design: Use for REST, GraphQL and event API contracts and error design.
descriptions.dpe-database-engineering: Use for schemas, indexes, query plans, transactions and migrations.
descriptions.dpe-cybersecurity-risk: Use for security review: auth, injection, trust boundaries, abuse.
descriptions.dpe-performance-profiling: Use for profiling and bottlenecks: CPU, memory, queries, caching.
descriptions.dpe-ci-cd-pipelines: Use to design, speed up or fix CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
descriptions.ci-triage: Use to classify a failing CI run: flake, regression, environment, config.
descriptions.dpe-react-development: Use for React/TypeScript components, hooks, state and data fetching.
descriptions.dpe-qa-automation-strategy: Use for test strategy: Playwright, Cypress, integration, regression.
descriptions.accessibility: Use for WCAG 2.2 AA builds and audits: keyboard, contrast, screen readers.
descriptions.dpe-ui-ux-design-to-code: Use for UI review, design-to-code, responsive layout, mockups.
descriptions.dpe-github-workflow: Use for GitHub issues, PRs, Actions, releases and dependency updates.
descriptions.dpe-handoff: Use to write a continuation brief for another agent or session.
descriptions.malaysia-localisation: Use as DPE’s default voice: short, simple Malaysian English, BM or rojak; also for localisation tasks.
